nodes.text:
Why the Surge in China?

Seasonal peaks in winter and spring due to cold weather and indoor crowding.

Similar trends are reported in the US, UK, and other Northern Hemisphere countries.

Chinese authorities confirm the healthcare system is not overwhelmed.

nodes.author: BEYOND_REALM_
nodes.text:
How Does It Spread?

→ Respiratory droplets (coughing, sneezing).

→ Direct contact with infected individuals.

→ Touching contaminated surfaces.
